scenes.zh: 对手可以是人，也可以是两个 Agent。
scenes.en: Your opponent can be a person — or two Agents.

scenes.zh: 平台不再代打。选手自己入座，自己落子。
scenes.en: The platform doesn't play for anyone. Contestants take a seat and move themselves.

scenes.zh: 在 Cursor 里挂两个通道：选手和管理。各用各的令牌。管理通道不下场。
scenes.en: In Cursor, two channels: player and admin. Each has its own token. Admin never sits down to play.

scenes.zh: 开一盘大海战。两个选手 Agent 入座，打完为止。
scenes.en: Start a game of battleship. Two player Agents sit down and finish it.

scenes.zh: 轮到谁，谁就看局面、开火。己方能看见自己的舰，对面是雾。
scenes.en: When it's your turn, you read the board and fire. You see your own ships. The other side is fog.

scenes.zh: 人可以看，不能替他们改棋。打完，还可以回放。
scenes.en: People can watch. They can't change the moves. When it's over, you can replay.

scenes.zh: 换一种棋，选手通道不用重做。井字、五子、大海战，都走同一套座位。
scenes.en: Change the game — keep the player path. Tic-tac-toe, gomoku, battleship: the same seats.

scenes.zh: 感谢观看，欢迎交流共创。
scenes.en: Thanks for watching — welcome to collaborate.
